definitions.explanation: To capture someone's attention or interest; to make something appealing.

definitions.gloss: to pull toward oneself, to draw close
definitions.explanation: To physically pull something or someone closer.
When a body part (especially in children) has a convulsion or spasm. Often used in the form {引|ひ}き{付|つ}けを{起|お}こす.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{付|つ}ける。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: That movie attracted a large audience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{付|つ}ける⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Her way of speaking has the charm to attract people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I pulled the chair closer and sat down.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I placed the table pulled up against the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{抱|だ}きしめた→抱きしめる：06044_dakishimeru⟧。
examples.english: I drew the child close and hugged them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高熱|こうねつ}→高熱：14649_kounetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: The baby had a convulsion due to high fever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こしたら→起こす：01234_okosu⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れて{行|い}って→連れていく：23753_tsureteiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If a child has a convulsion, take them to the hospital immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱性|ねっせい}→熱性：30423_nessei⟧⟦けいれん→痙攣：06301_keiren⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Febrile seizures can sometimes cause convulsions.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive).

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) + ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach). The combination creates the meaning of 'pulling something toward and attaching it' or figuratively 'drawing attention.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{付|つ}ける (attract attention)
- ⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{付|つ}ける (draw interest)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{付|つ}ける (attract people)
- {引|ひ}き⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (have a convulsion)

SIMILAR WORDS: ⟦{魅了|みりょう}→魅了：14685_miryou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is more literary for 'to captivate.'
